# Set Up
This page provides a sample repeat measurements report for the repeat-measure vital sign KRIs (`kri0020a`-`f`, `cou0020a`-`f`), generated using the `gsm.kri` package. Expand the "Setup" section below to see the code used to generate the report. Or scroll down for the standard report output.

<details>
<summary>Setup</summary>

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(gsm.core)
library(gsm.mapping)
library(gsm.reporting)
library(gsm.kri)

# --- Step 1: Map the subject and vital signs data -----------------------------
mappings_wf <- MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = c("SUBJ", "VS"),
  strPath = "workflow/1_mappings",
  strPackage = "gsm.mapping",
  bExact = TRUE
)
lRaw <- Ingest(gsm.core::lSource, CombineSpecs(mappings_wf))
lMapped <- RunWorkflows(mappings_wf, lRaw)

# --- Step 2: Run the repeat-measure KRIs --------------------------------------
metrics_wf <- MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = c(paste0("kri0020", letters[1:6]), paste0("cou0020", letters[1:6])),
  strPath = "workflow/2_metrics",
  strPackage = "gsm.kri",
  bExact = TRUE
)
lAnalyzed <- RunWorkflows(metrics_wf, lMapped)

# --- Step 3: Bind the reporting results and metrics ---------------------------
dSnapshotDate <- Sys.Date()
dfResults <- BindResults(
  lAnalyzed,
  "Analysis_Summary",
  dSnapshotDate = dSnapshotDate,
  strStudyID = unique(lMapped$Mapped_SUBJ$studyid)[1]
)
dfMetrics <- MakeMetric(metrics_wf)

lListings <- list(
  Mapped_VS = lMapped$Mapped_VS,
  Mapped_SUBJ = lMapped$Mapped_SUBJ
)
```

</details>

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
## Render example report inline using knit_child
child_env <- list2env(
  list(
    params = list(
      dfResults = dfResults,
      dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
      lListings = lListings,
      dSnapshotDate = dSnapshotDate,
      nWindowLength = NULL,
      strFlagRule = "count",
      vFlagThresholds = NULL,
      nMinWindows = 1,
      strBPMode = "separate",
      bExport = TRUE
    )
  ),
  parent = environment()
)
report_repeat_measurements <- knitr::knit_child(
  system.file("report", "Report_RepeatMeasurements.Rmd", package = "gsm.kri"),
  envir = child_env,
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(report_repeat_measurements, sep = "\n")
```
